question: Should the unrelated unused exports be removed or separately reviewed before this facade cleanup is allowed to change the ratchet baseline?
rationale: The current generated diff trades a valid seven-entry net reduction for ten newly accepted unrelated exports, and accepting that enforcement debt is a maintainer-owned merge-risk choice.

options.title: Keep the ratchet narrow
options.body: Regenerate on current main and require this PR to contain only the path-safety baseline removals, handling other unused exports in their owning modules or separate PRs.

options.title: Explicitly accept new debt
options.body: Approve the ten unrelated allowlist additions with an owner-backed explanation for why those exports must remain temporarily accepted.

options.title: Pause the cleanup
options.body: Close or defer this PR if an exact-main regeneration cannot produce a reviewable, narrowly attributable baseline change.

recommendation.title: Keep the ratchet narrow
recommendation.body: Regenerate on current main and require this PR to contain only the path-safety baseline removals, handling other unused exports in their owning modules or separate PRs.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the enforced export ratchet and have the strongest recent history on both affected files.
